description.value: The Joint Pizzeria is a Victoria institution on Wharf Street, born in 2001 from the ashes of a late-night slice spot called Zombies and now run by a new generation of owners committed to its legacy. It serves hand-crafted specialty and custom pizzas with a notably broad range of dietary accommodations, including a house-made gluten-free rice crust and fully vegan build options. The location near the inner harbour waterfront and its late-night hours make it a convenient stop for cyclists exploring downtown Victoria.
